name: tamlil-voice
description: Talk to Claude Code in Hebrew: /listen records your voice and transcribes it on your Mac with Tamlil's ivrit.ai whisper model.

language.title: Language
language.description: Spoken language passed to whisper (he for Hebrew, auto to detect).

modelPath.title: Model file
modelPath.description: Path to a whisper.cpp .bin model. Empty: the ivrit.ai model Tamlil downloaded.

autoSend.title: Send at once
autoSend.description: Send the transcript as your prompt instead of leaving it in the box to check.

speakReplies.title: Read replies aloud
speakReplies.description: Speak Claude's answer to a spoken prompt with the macOS voice below.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: macOS voice for spoken replies (Carmit is the Hebrew one).

silenceSeconds.title: Stop after silence (seconds)
silenceSeconds.description: Recording stops by itself after this much silence; 0 records until /listen again.

maxSeconds.title: Longest recording (seconds)
maxSeconds.description: Recording stops by itself after this long.
